description:

The cars: @PetersenMuseum  / https://www.instagram.com/petersenmuseum/
The cars: @thevipersguy  / https://www.instagram.com/thevipersguy/

………………………………………………………………………………………..

It’s the one you’ve all been waiting for - Fast & Furious drag race!! 

We’ve got our hands on the most iconic cars from the first Fast and Furious movie, and we’re running a winner-stays-on showdown to see which is the ultimate car from this world-famous franchise! 

Unfortunately, unlike the movie, none of these cars are tuned. But that’s not going to stop us racing them! So let’s take a closer look at what’s on offer: 

- Mitsubishi Eclipse: 
2-litre 4-cylinder, 140hp & 176Nm, FWD, 5-speed manual & 1,300kg

- Acura Integra: 
1.8-litre 4-cylinder, 170hp & 174Nm, FWD, 5-speed manual & 1,170kg

- Honda Civic: 
1.6-litre 4-cyli
title: Fast & Furious Toyota Supra v Dodge Charger: DRAG RACE
